about_the_game:
Explore the quirky town of Larcenest gap as a reporter, complete wholesome quests, and write your own reports with total creative freedom.

Nothing Strange Here is an open-world game where you play as Bennie, a reporter investigating strange mysteries, helping the town's citizens, and documenting your adventures in self-written news reports. Your words are your own—choose to write heartfelt journalism, dry facts, or total nonsense. 

While the town is full of cozy side quests and lighthearted encounters, a larger mystery slowly unfolds — one that leads to unexpected events and cliffhangers.

Interact with characters, take photographs with your camera and write articles in your journal. 

With flexible gameplay, a journal system for personal notes and theories, and a world that rewards curiosity and observation — Nothing Strange Here is a cozy, mysterious, and often bizarre journey through the everyday strangeness of a town that definitely has something to hide.
